title: ChatGPT became my main development assistant while building a Unity survival RPG
author: eldoreste
selftext:
I’m a solo developer from Brazil building a survival RPG in Unity and ChatGPT became my main development assistant during production.

I used it mostly for:

system structure planning  
debug reasoning  
UI logic design  
inventory architecture  
dialogue systems  
gameplay balancing decisions

It didn’t build the game for me — it helped me understand how to build it.

For someone working alone this changed what was possible.

This is the Steam page:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4636420/Once\_Upon\_a\_Time\_After\_the\_End/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4636420/Once_Upon_a_Time_After_the_End/)

Demo submitted and waiting for approval.

Curious what other devs here are building using AI support.

comments.author: angrylittledev
comments.body: The main problem is the GPT's "art style" it's so on the nose and easily recognizable that it puts people off almost instantly, even people who like AI. Animations look somewhat decent but everything else looks too stiff.

replies.author: eldoreste
replies.body: In the next game that I create I will try to improve the art. Thank you

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: Use Gemini for art, it an mimic almost any style, find the art style you like, then give it to Gemini, try like 5-10 images and tell it to 'analyze this style, I want consistent artwork in this style" and it will do a good job, sometimes it hallucinates but for the most part it does good. Even on free tier.

replies.author: eldoreste
replies.body: Thanks for the tip, my friend. I'll test the Gemini. Thank you very much. Hugs.

replies.author: Disposable110
replies.body: I built half a hobby RPG 20 years ago and hired an artist and what I got back looked EXACTLY like this, lol. Characters, UI panels, environments, everything! Gameplay was completely different though.

comments.author: Crawling_Hustler
comments.body:
Congrats on finishing the game. And it looks pretty in depth than usual AI slop. 

How did u get the voice tho ? It sounds pretty good for narration

replies.author: eldoreste
